items.title: OpenAI's Cursor Ban Is About Astra
items.summary:
Cursor not getting access to Astra is BIG news but it makes sense at this point, even if we don't like it 

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

items.author: Theo - t3․gg
items.transcript: We're ending our partnership with Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX. This isn't about some new development in OpenAI versus Cursor. This is because Astra apparently is a better enough model that OpenAI is concerned about distillation of Astra and as such is making sure any company that isn't compliant with the terms of service is not allowed to get Astra within their existing contract.
